title: VerificationReport
description: v0.9 (additive): programs with EXEC SQL in the verified subset also run on a seeded stand-in database (SQLite, never real DB2), the same seed on each side, and the final contents of every table the program touched are compared value for value: runs.database, and one result per table (outputDd `table:NAME`, inputSource `database`). Output of services/verifier (GnuCOBOL differential testing). v0.8 (additive): programs with no output file are compared on stdout and exit code (one result, inputSource and outputDd `stdout`, runs.stdoutCompared true; refused if the original printed nothing); sequential files opened I-O are seeded from generated records and their final contents compared byte for byte (runs.files.updated). v0.3: per-case input, input source and field-level diffs; run metadata; v0.3 adds exitCodeMatch (RETURN-CODE), the pinned clock and the collating sequence; v0.4 adds golden-file replay against captured mainframe output; v0.5 adds multi-file programs (results per output DD). v0.6: outputs compared as a sequence by position and byte for byte (inputSource 'output', fieldDiffs note). v0.7 adds jobs[] (additive): whole-JCL-job differential tests (v1 scope: one SORT step feeding one COBOL step), one certificate per job.

input.description: The input record used for this case, as fed to both programs.

inputSource.description: How the input was generated. 'files': an output record of a multi-file run, whose inputs are whole generated files. 'output': a record of a program whose outputs do not map one to one to its inputs (aggregation, fan-out); compared by position in the output.

fieldDiffs.description: Fields whose values differ between original and converted output.

note.description: e.g. 'same value, different bytes' (+00 vs -00): records must match byte for byte

oracle.description: What the converted output was compared with: GnuCOBOL's output, or a captured mainframe output (golden).

outputDd.description: Output file (DD name) this record belongs to, for programs with several output files; 'stdout' for the single stdout/exit-code result of a DISPLAY-only program.

runs.description: How each side was built and run.

database.description: Additive (v0.9). The database the program ran against. Engine and subset are stated so the claim stays honest: equivalent on THIS engine for THESE statements on the inputs tried.

engine.description: e.g. sqlite (a stand-in; DECIMAL is stored as an integer scaled by 10^scale so no float rounding enters)

subset.description: Version tag of the verified SQL subset.

seededFrom.description: Where the tables came from: the schema source files and 'generated rows (seed N)'.

sqlcodeCompared.description: True: SQLCODE values reach the program's own output, so they are compared through it.

changedFromSeed.description: Additive. Whether each side left the table different from its seed; a program with write statements where no table changed on either side is not certified.

row.description: 1-based row in canonical order (all columns ascending, NULL first)

stdoutCompared.description: Additive (v0.8). True when stdout and exit code are the program's only compared output (a DISPLAY-only program); results then holds one `stdout` result.

exitCodeMatch.description: Both programs ended with the same exit code (COBOL RETURN-CODE).

clock.description: Date and time both programs saw (COB_CURRENT_DATE / DIOCLE_CLOCK, UTC).

collation.description: Collating sequence for alphanumeric comparisons and sorts (ebcdic = mainframe order).

golden.description: Golden-file replay: captured mainframe inputs and outputs, converted from EBCDIC field by field.

oracleAgreement.description: Golden cases where GnuCOBOL's output equals the mainframe's

oracleDisagreements.description: Where GnuCOBOL differs from the mainframe; the mainframe is the authority

aligned.description: False when captured inputs and outputs do not pair one to one; every golden case then fails

files.description: Multi-file runs: records per input DD, and records each side wrote per output DD.

updated.description: Additive (v0.8). Files opened I-O, by DD: records seeded, and records each side left in the file.

jobs.description: Additive (v0.7). Whole-JCL-job differential tests: one entry per job (v1 scope: one SORT step feeding one COBOL step, see services/verifier/diocle_verifier/jobs.py). One certificate per job, independent of the top-level single-program results[] above.

steps.description: Per-step pass/fail, one entry per step in job order.

outputDds.description: Output DD names compared for this step.

passed.description: True only if every one of this step's outputDds matched byte for byte.

results.description: Same item shape as the top-level results[] above, each additionally tagged with which step produced it.

step.description: Which job step this output record came from.

runs.description: How the job's one kind:"cobol" step compiled and ran (original) vs the whole generated pipeline's driver (converted).

exitCodeMatch.description: Both sides' final step ended with the same exit code.

certified.description: True only if both sides ran, every step passed, and every output DD on every step matched byte for byte. One certificate per job: a single failing step or DD makes the whole job not certified.
